svg.title: Four lines of attack on reliable embedded software
svg.desc: Four complementary lines of work meet at practical assurance. Understanding failure asks what goes wrong in real embedded software, through studies of packet validation and layering violations. Making code reachable asks how firmware can be analyzed away from its target hardware, through rehosting, LEMIX and bottom-up testing. Analyzing at scale asks whether useful analyses can become cheap enough to apply broadly, using CodeQL and OSS-Fuzz-Gen. Establishing guarantees asks whether verification can become an ordinary engineering step, through Unit Proofing, compositional bounded model checking and AutoSOUP.
svg.text: Four lines of attack on reliable embedded software
Embedded systems defeat analysis in different ways. Reliable engineering requires complementary methods.
1 — UNDERSTAND FAILURE
What goes wrong in real embedded software?
Empirical studies expose recurring defect classes and
identify where existing engineering practices fail.
Packet validation · layering violations
2 — MAKE CODE REACHABLE
How can firmware be analyzed away from its hardware?
Rehosting and bottom-up execution remove the hardware
and environment dependencies that keep ordinary testing
and analysis from reaching embedded code.
Rehosting · LEMIX · reactive bottom-up testing
3 — ANALYZE AT SCALE
Can useful analyses become cheap enough to apply broadly?
Static analysis and automated test generation move from
individual systems to populations of real projects — and
expose the practical barriers to doing so.
CodeQL · OSS-Fuzz-Gen
4 — ESTABLISH GUARANTEES
Can verification become an ordinary engineering step?
Unit Proofing uses component-level bounded verification
and automated proof construction to move from finding
memory-safety defects toward establishing their absence.
Unit Proofing · compositional BMC · AutoSOUP
PRACTICAL
ASSURANCE
No single technique solves embedded assurance. The programme attacks complementary barriers: knowing what to look for,
reaching the code, making analysis affordable, and strengthening the result from defect detection toward guarantees.
